waypoints.name: Andrews Creek Trailhead
waypoints.directions: Getting here is simple driving: from Winthrop, head north up the Chewuch River valley on West Chewuch Road / FR-51, paved the whole way, about 23 miles to the Andrews Creek Trailhead at roughly 3,040 ft. Andrews Creek Trail #504 starts from the lot. Sort the free self-issue wilderness permit at the trailhead before you leave the car, and display a trailhead parking pass. Day one is a 17 to 20 mile hike to Upper Cathedral Lake, so arrive with the whole day in front of you.
